summary: Discusses how a node chooses which lower-priority TE LSPs to preempt when a higher-priority one needs room, and how preempted LSPs are rerouted by their head-end routers. This memo is informational.

eli5.summary: If a VIP needs seats on a full bus, someone has to give up theirs. This explains how a router picks which paths to bump so as few people as possible are bothered.
